gaps.gap: The ecosystem is institutionally distributed; a single coherent command hierarchy over all actors is not established.
Platform-specific or regulator-specific content actions must be traced case by case under DSA or national law; INV-043/045 own those downstream questions.
A benchmark does not show that any specific moderation decision was caused by EU institutions or by a fact-checking organisation.
Formal safeguards do not prove perfect practical independence; conversely funding alone does not prove command.
Parliament’s committee recommendation had not yet itself created the requested legal powers as of the run date.
No common 2026 outcome metric links the entire Shield ecosystem to reduced manipulation, improved voter autonomy or a counterfactual democratic outcome.
Direct signal-to-moderation attribution and I5-I7 persuasion/behavior/counterfactual effects are not established at ecosystem level.
